definitions.explanation: The soft, greenish-yellow substance inside a crab's shell — a mix of the digestive gland and other innards — eaten as a rich, prized delicacy despite the name having nothing to do with miso paste.

examples.japanese: {蟹味噌|かにみそ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{蟹味噌|かにみそ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{濃厚|のうこう}→濃厚：07905_noukou⟧な⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧がする。
examples.english: Crab tomalley has a rich, intense flavor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{甲羅|こうら}→甲羅：21848_koura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧{蟹味噌|かにみそ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}いで→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧もいる。
examples.english: Some people pour sake into the shell to drink with the leftover tomalley.

notes:
{蟹味噌|かにみそ} contains ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧ only because of its miso-like color and creamy texture — it is not made from soybeans and has no relation to actual miso paste.

- {蟹味噌|かにみそ}⟦{甲羅|こうら}→甲羅：21848_koura⟧{焼|や}き: crab tomalley grilled in the shell
